title: Movies
noTmdb: Without a TMDB key the titles are kept as the sites name them, with no posters and no search.

empty.title: Nothing watched yet
empty.text: The browser extension notes a film or a show on any site that plays it — Netflix, a site with a player of its own. Install the extension and sign in to it.

empty.title: The list is empty
empty.text: Find a film or a show above and add it.

unknown.hint: Videos the dashboard could not find in TMDB. Find the film by hand, or put the view aside — and a site you do not want noted can be left alone (its views go).

integration.subtitle: Films and shows: titles, posters, search
integration.hint: A TMDB key finds what you watched among films and shows and gives the search of the list to watch.
integration.key: API key or API Read Access Token
integration.track: Note what plays in the browser
integration.trackHint: The browser extension tells the dashboard which video plays on which site — never the page's address. Private windows and the private words of Activity are left out.

guide.2: Settings → API → "Create" → "Developer", fill in the form (a personal project).
guide.3: Copy the "API Key" or the "API Read Access Token".
guide.4: Paste it here and save: what was watched without a key is found again.
